subtitle: 两个服务同时连着，其中一个断了怎么办

exercises.title: 两个服务：握手、命名与权限

question.zh-CN: 宿主连上馆藏和借阅两个服务，给工具加服务前缀，探测可用性，再试三种越权调用，最后关闭全部连接。
question.en: The host connects the catalog and loan desk services, prefixes their tools, probes them, tries three calls beyond its permissions, then closes every connection.

exercises.title: 借阅服务崩溃：第二次重连成功

question.zh-CN: 登记一笔借阅后杀掉借阅服务进程，断连期间再写一笔；第一次重启的服务一启动就退出，第二次成功，再看哪些写入会重发。
question.en: After one loan is registered, the loan desk process is killed and a second write goes out during the disconnect; the first restart exits at once, the second works, and we see which writes get resent.

exercises.title: 两次重连都失败，放弃重连

question.zh-CN: 同样杀掉借阅服务，但前两次重启的服务都一启动就退出；重连上限是 2 次，用完之后宿主放弃，再看运行怎么收尾。
question.en: The loan desk is killed again, but both restarts exit as soon as they start; with a reconnect limit of 2 the host gives up, and you see how the run finishes.

exercises.title: 重连超时，回来的服务换了定义

question.zh-CN: 同样杀掉借阅服务；第一次重启的服务不回应握手，等到读超时；第二次连上的是更新过的版本，登记借阅的参数变了。
question.en: The loan desk is killed again; the first restart never answers the handshake and hits the read timeout; the second connects to an updated version whose loan registration takes different arguments.

exercises.title: 模型通过两个服务借书，中途断连

question.zh-CN: 帮读者 M-07 找一本讲工具调用的书，登记借阅，然后查一下他的借阅记录确认登记成功。
question.en: Find a book about tool calling for member M-07, register the loan, then look up the member's loans to confirm it.

ui.question_help: 只有“模型通过两个服务借书，中途断连”把这里的文字作为用户问题发给模型；其余四个练习由运行器按固定步骤调用服务，这里的文字只记为备注。
